Requirement: Production selector returns the cheapest valid plan/composition
Evidence: Audit oracle (8 928 scenarios): production matches cheapest in 6 896 (77.24%); 2 032 (22.76%) have a strictly cheaper valid alternative that production rejects. Random test (2 000 cases): 234/1 999 (11.7%) mismatch, all on production's side (never cheaper).
ExploitOrFailureMode: Customer paying strictly more than the cheapest valid combination in ~12-23% of cases (depending on configured prices). Pricing is server-authoritative so customer cannot self-correct.
ProductionBlocker: Yes (production cannot ship as-is without business decision)
RecommendedFix: Replace priority-wins selection with cheapest-first selection; or keep priority-wins but document the gap and obtain explicit product sign-off. The fix is a one-line change in selector + new oracle regression test.
RequiredTests: Re-run audit-exhaustive and audit-property-random; aim for 100% match.
Dependencies: Product sign-off on cheapest-first vs priority-wins
